slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110-hour weekly production time limit a hard cap that cannot be exceeded without incurring overtime, or is it the standard shift capacity where any production beyond 110 hours is defined as overtime?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the nature of the 110-hour boundary (hard cap vs. regular capacity), which touches the hard/soft issue, but it never asked whether fully utilizing the 110 hours is itself a goal nor about its priority relative to minimizing overtime, so the goal-programming meaning of U10 is not fully covered.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the total weekly production time (regular plus overtime) capped at 120 hours, or is the 110-hour regular capacity a hard limit and the 10-hour overtime a separate hard limit that together define the maximum total production time?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the existence of an overtime maximum (turn 3) and whether the 10-hour overtime is a hard limit (turn 8), touching the strict-constraint side, but it never asked whether the 10-hour rule is a soft target to be met as closely as possible nor about its priority versus minimizing overtime.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110-hour regular capacity is merely a capacity threshold with no requirement or goal to fully utilize it.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only asked whether 110 hours is a hard cap or the regular capacity; it never asked whether fully utilizing the 110 hours is itself a goal, so the omission of any utilization goal in the model is unconfirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: At READY_TO_MODEL both P0 goal-structure slots were only partially surfaced: the agent established the hard/soft nature of the 110-hour and 10-hour bounds but never investigated their role as prioritized soft goals, so the preemptive goal-programming structure remained unresolved when it committed to a hard-constraint LP.

summary: The agent ran a broad, mostly effective clarification interview, pinning down the objective, capacity, production rate, sales floors, the descriptive role of profit, and the 120-hour cap. However, it only probed the hard/soft nature of the 110-hour and 10-hour overtime bounds and never uncovered their role as prioritized goals, so both P0 goal-programming slots were only partially recovered before it entered READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
